repairs.question: n36-rectangle
repairs.before: Ignore one planar displacement in MC and ignore the zero planar displacement in MA, then use one pictured rectangle side to label MB longest and its opposite connection MD shortest.
repairs.after: After finding the right angles at B and D, compare only MB and MD, unjustifiably assume AB>AD, and use MB^2-MD^2=AB^2-AD^2>0. Then falsely report the larger and smaller members of this restricted pair as the longest and shortest among all four segments, omitting MC and MA.

repairs.question: n36-triangle-construction
repairs.before: The lines through M and N parallel to MN are the same normal line, meeting alpha only at F. For the depicted interior F they do not meet any side line, so they cannot supply the requested feet.
repairs.after: The lines through M and N parallel to MN are the same normal line, meeting alpha only at F. The three side lines of a nondegenerate triangle do not all pass through one point F, so this fixed normal cannot meet all three side lines and cannot supply all requested feet. This failure is independent of whether F is inside, outside, on a side, or at a vertex.
